idea-plugin.name: Parquet Viewer
idea-plugin.description:
Parquet Viewer - The Ultimate Tool for Big Data Geeks.

Parquet Viewer is a lightweight, high-performance IntelliJ IDEA plugin designed for developers who need to inspect .parquet files with precision and style.
Version 2.3 brings native numeric sorting, regex filtering, and a "Gamer Mode" for the UI.

🚀 Extreme Performance:
  • Instant Open: Reads metadata in O(1) time. Opens GB-sized files instantly.
  • Smart IO: Implements Row Group Skipping and Column Projection to minimize memory usage.
✨ Geeky Features:
  • Native Sorting: Correctly sorts numeric columns (Int, Long, Double) by value, not by string.
  • X-Ray Schema: View compression ratio, null percentage, and data size directly in the schema tree.
  • Hex View: Right-click any cell to inspect raw binary data and debug encoding issues.
  • Code Gen: Generate Hive DDL and Java POJO from schema with one click.
🎨 Modern UI & Easter Eggs:
  • Data Grid: Excel-style row headers, zebra striping, and explicit <null> rendering.
  • Geek Mode: Try typing rgb or phil in the filter box for a surprise! 🌈

idea-plugin.change-notes:
2.3.0 - The "Rainbow" Update

  • 🔢 Improvement: Implemented Native Numeric Sorting. Integers and Floats now sort by value instead of lexicographically.
  • 🌈 Easter Eggs: Added hidden visual modes. Try typing rgb or phil in the filter field!
  • 🎨 UI Polish: Fixed Zebra Striping rendering issues for numeric columns.
  • 🐛 Fix: Resolved MVEL class loader issues to ensure stable filtering expression execution.
  • 🚀 Performance: Further optimized Lazy Map evaluation for complex filters.
